# Camera Profiling

## Purpose

Create or evaluate a defensible camera color transform/profile for a repeatable camera
recording mode.

## Reference links

Authority references:

- [ACES IDT Capture Guide](cards/aces-idt-capture-guide.md)
- [ACES 2 Color Management](cards/aces-2-color-management.md)
- [DCamProf Camera Profiling](cards/dcamprof-camera-profiling.md)
- [OpenColorIO Documentation](cards/opencolorio-docs.md)

## First decision: profile or correct?

Use profiling only when the goal is to characterize a repeatable camera + encoding mode.

Do **not** create a profile merely because one production clip has bad WB or exposure.
That is a shot correction problem.

## Capture requirements

Follow the ACES capture guide rather than improvising:

- neutral grey card;
- 24-patch ColorChecker;
- controlled, even, high-quality illumination;
- manual camera setup;
- processing/AWB/auto-exposure disabled;
- intended recording encoding;
- base ISO and logged settings;
- measured illumination;
- bracketed response around nominal exposure;
- redundant captures and complete metadata.

Reject the profiling run if capture conditions are materially uncontrolled.

## Workflow

### 1. Preserve raw calibration material

Copy nothing destructively and record file hashes where practical.

### 2. Inventory capture metadata

Record:

```text
camera body and firmware
lens
recording mode / codec
log or transfer curve
gamut setting
ISO
aperture
shutter
white balance
light source / measured CCT
chart model
exposure bracket
```

### 3. Detect/sample chart patches

Chart detection may be automated, but save the detected geometry and patch crops so a
human or another agent can audit them.

Reject:

- clipped patches;
- contaminated reflections;
- uneven illumination;
- motion blur;
- chart edge occlusion;
- clearly wrong patch correspondence.

### 4. Generate the transform

Preferred path for an ACES workflow:

```text
controlled capture
  -> ACES IDT tooling/calculator
  -> Input Transform
  -> OCIO/ACES integration
```

Alternative DCP/ICC path:

```text
target measurements
  -> DCamProf
  -> DCP/ICC
```

Do not conflate the two output families.

### 5. Validate on held-out material

The fitting chart is not sufficient validation.

Test:

- neutral scale;
- skin;
- saturated colors;
- under/overexposed bracket material;
- at least one ordinary scene not used for fitting.

Compare against a known/reference transform when available.

### 6. Version and document

Store:

```text
capture set
target measurements
tool versions
generation command/config
profile/IDT artifact
validation report
known limitations
```

## Decision

Return one of:

```text
ACCEPT PROFILE
ACCEPT FOR LIMITED USE
RECAPTURE CALIBRATION MATERIAL
REJECT PROFILE
USE MANUFACTURER/ACES TRANSFORM INSTEAD
```

## Anti-patterns

- Building a camera profile from arbitrary edited footage.
- Capturing the ColorChecker under mixed or uneven light.
- Leaving AWB or dynamic picture processing enabled.
- Fitting and validating on exactly the same chart frames.
- Assuming a lower numerical patch error always produces better real-world rendering.
